WITH film_actor_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
), first_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count
  FROM film_actor_counts
), above_first AS (
  SELECT c.film_id, c.actor_count, c.actor_count - a.avg_count AS excess_over_first
  FROM film_actor_counts c
  CROSS JOIN first_average a
  WHERE c.actor_count > a.avg_count
), second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count
  FROM above_first
), above_second AS (
  SELECT f.actor_count, f.excess_over_first,
         f.actor_count - a.avg_count AS excess_over_second
  FROM above_first f
  CROSS JOIN second_average a
  WHERE f.actor_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS sum_actor_counts,
       AVG(excess_over_first) AS avg_excess_over_first,
       AVG(excess_over_second) AS avg_excess_over_second
FROM above_second;
